## Working of FULL JOIN

![Right and Left Tables](data:image/png;base64,)

This query returns all rows from both the Customers and Orders tables:

- Rows with matching customer_id will display combined data.
- Rows without a match in either table will display NULL for the columns of the unmatched table.
